stem:
Zara is told an animal lives in both pond and muddy bank and breathes in air and water at different times.

How should she classify the habitat?

options.text: Only terrestrial, because it sometimes sits on the bank.
Amphibian habitat: both land and water.
Only aquatic, because it has to be in water all day.
Neither, because habitat is just the name of the animal.

teacher.key_rationale: Living on land and in water is an amphibian habitat. Forcing only-land or only-water drops one of the conditions.
